jay_cust: Hey team — redeemed promo code via the webflow flow yesterday, got the green check and confirmation email saying 50 USD credits applied, but org balance is still $0.00. Can you check?
elllen_support: Sorry about that, can you paste your org id and the email used to redeem? Also any Tx id from the email? :slightly_frowning_face:
jay_cust: Org: org_9b3f, email: jay@example.com, email shows Grant ID G-98765 and timestamp 2026-03-14T18:22Z
ellen_support: Thanks. I'll pull the ledger and webhook traces. One sec.
ledger_bot: webhook: /promo/redeem returned 200 OK for grant_id=G-98765 payload_id=pl_44c; queued for ledger ingestion
ellen_support: Ledger ingest shows an insert attempt but then a DB error — escalating to billing. @ravi_billing can you take a look?
ravi_billing: looking now. I see an attempted write to grants table failed with a duplicate constraint on unique(grant_id). Log: ```ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "grants_pkey" Detail: Key (grant_id)=(G-98765) already exists. SQLSTATE=23505```
ellen_support: So the webhook was retried and the second attempt got rejected so no new balance change was recorded?
ravi_billing: It looks like the first write created a stub row (status=ingested=false) but the post-ingest job that sets amounts failed due to a race on grant processing. The second webhook attempt then got rejected by the DB unique constraint and our retry handler didn't reconcile the stub.
maya_prod: This is a known edge case in the grant ingestion flow when webhook retries interleave with async reconciler. We filed a mitigation in internal ticket RINF-4853 but not yet shipped. Quick question: can you confirm whether the stub row has amount=null?
ravi_billing: Yes — I queried grants where grant_id='G-98765' -> status='pending', amount=NULL, created_at=2026-03-14T18:22:02Z
ellen_support: Thanks — Jay, we can apply the credit manually now and follow up with a permanent fix. Would you like a manual grant of $50 to be posted to your org ledger while we fix the ingestion path?
jay_cust: Please do, that would unblock us. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
ravi_billing: Manual entry scheduled. I'll post a journal entry and link to the grant. ETA ~10m.
ledger_bot: journal_entry: JE-33121 created for org_9b3f amount=50.00 currency=USD linked_grant=G-98765 status=posted
ellen_support: I see the balance now reflects $50.00 on our side — Jay, can you refresh and confirm? :eyes:
jay_cust: Refreshing... yep balance shows $50. Thank you!! :tada:
ellen_support: Closing loop: created internal follow-up RINF-4853 (owner @maya_prod) to harden dedupe/reconcile path so pending stubs get auto-completed if duplicate webhook arrives. Timeline: patch slated for 2026-03-20, data-migration to reconcile similar stubs scheduled.
maya_prod: We'll add an observability alert for pending grants older than 10m and a reconciliation job to pick up null-amount stubs.
ellen_support: I'll keep this thread open until the fix ships, but your credits are applied now. Sorry for the disruption and thanks for the quick repro details, Jay.
jay_cust: Great, thanks everyone. If I see anything odd I'll reopen.
ellen_support: Filed a short postmortem and flagged as Sev-3 for product. Follow-up sent to the customer success team for outreach. :white_check_mark:
